description.value: Ricky's is a Canadian family restaurant chain with over 60 years of history, serving all-day breakfast, lunch, and dinner in a full-service dining room. The Ladner location is a dual-branded Ricky's Famoso facility offering dine-in, takeout, and delivery via Skip the Dishes and UberEats. It sits on Ladner Trunk Road and provides a reliable, family-casual meal stop with a broad menu that includes vegetarian options.
